subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Paramount
solution:
The correct answer is '**supreme**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**supreme**" means highest in rank or authority. (सर्वोच्च)
 
• Paramount importance or paramount consideration means the highest priority or the utmost importance.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The safety of the passengers is of paramount__ importance.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Inferior (निम्न)**: means lower in rank, status, or quality.
 
• **Collateral (संपार्श्विक)**: means something pledged as security for repayment of a loan.
 
• **Trivial (तुच्छ)**: means of little value or importance.
